summary: Renderer resource teardown. Calls RenderTargetCleanup(0), then frees three sub-resources at this+0x152C, this+0x1524 and this+0x1528 via sub_53F6E0 (first only) followed by EmptyStub_7470/FreeWrapper_7bcf, nulling each pointer. Finally releases the sub-object at this+0x1100 through its vtable method at offset 8, stores the call result into *this and nulls this+0x1100.

operations.description: Unconditional RenderTargetCleanup(0) before any sub-resource teardown.
If pointer at this+0x152C is non-zero, release it; otherwise skip the first resource block.
Re-check the pointer at this+0x152C after the sub_53F6E0 call before freeing it.
EmptyStub_7470(this+0x152C) pre-release stub, then FreeWrapper_7bcf frees the pointer.
Null the first resource pointer: this+0x152C = 0.
If pointer at this+0x1524 is non-zero, free it.
EmptyStub_7470(this+0x1524) then FreeWrapper_7bcf frees the pointer.
Null the second resource pointer: this+0x1524 = 0.
If pointer at this+0x1528 is non-zero, free it.
EmptyStub_7470(this+0x1528) then FreeWrapper_7bcf frees the pointer.
Null the third resource pointer: this+0x1528 = 0.
If the sub-object pointer at this+0x1100 is non-zero, release it via its vtable.
Indirect __stdcall call through the sub-object's vtable at offset 8 (this+0x1100 + vtable[2]), i.e. the object's release method; result stored into *this and this+0x1100 is nulled.
Return the value produced by the vtable release call (or the prior result when it was null).
Invoked by sub_53E070 (0053E070) and GlobalDispatch (0055C040) as part of renderer/global teardown.
